nodes.label: OG Image — Kazakh (og-kk.jpg)
nodes.description: OpenGraph social share image for the Kazakh-language version of the site. Dark black-to-dark-gold gradient background. Left side: brand name 'RUH CONSTRUCTION' in small gold uppercase label at top. Three-line headline in white serif font: 'Кілтке дейін жөндеу. Бір команда.' followed by 'Бір жауапты.' in italic gold serif. Sub-headline: 'Алматыдағы пәтерлер, кеңселер, мейрамханалар'. Bottom-left: gold star rating '★ 2ГИС-те 5.0 · 23 баға'. Right side: large circular badge logo — gold ring with repeating 'RUH CONSTRUCTION' text around the perimeter, and inside a gold 3D building/skyscraper silhouette above the bold block-letter wordmark 'RUH' on a black background. Image approximately 1200x630 (standard OG).

nodes.label: OG Image — Russian (og-ru.jpg)
nodes.description: OpenGraph social share image for the Russian-language version of the site. Identical layout and branding to the Kazakh OG image. Dark black-to-dark-gold gradient background. Left side: 'RUH CONSTRUCTION' gold uppercase label at top. Three-line headline in white serif: 'Ремонт под ключ. Одна команда.' followed by 'Один ответственный.' in italic gold serif. Sub-headline: 'Квартиры, офисы, рестораны в Алматы'. Bottom-left: '★ 5.0 на 2ГИС · 23 оценки'. Right side: same circular gold badge logo with building silhouette and 'RUH' wordmark. Image approximately 1200x630 (standard OG).

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (apple-icon.png)
nodes.description: Apple touch icon / PWA icon for the RUH Construction site. Square image with pure black background. Center: simplified yellow/gold 3D building silhouette — three tall rectangular towers of varying heights suggesting a skyline — above the bold block-letter wordmark 'RUH' in black with yellow/gold fill. No rounded corners at the image level (iOS applies its own mask). Compact high-contrast design readable at small sizes, likely 180x180px.

nodes.label: App Icon / Favicon (icon.png)
nodes.description: Primary app icon and favicon for the RUH Construction site. Rounded-rectangle (superellipse) shape with deep black background — iOS/Android app icon style. Center: large yellow/gold 3D building/skyscraper silhouette with three towers rendered with faceted 3D shading (golden-yellow faces, darker amber shadow faces) giving volume and depth. Below the building: bold block-letter wordmark 'RUH' in black outlined with gold. High-fidelity version of apple-icon with detailed 3D shading. Likely 512x512px or 1024x1024px.
